notes: Scrub engine lives in src/main.js (initFrameScrub). It loads /frames/<sequence>/sheet-XX.jpg and draws the sub-rectangle for the current frame.
Set CDN_FRAME_BASE in src/main.js to serve sheets from a CDN instead of /frames/.
Perfume sections (CanvasScrub, src/sections/canvasScrub.js) use LOOSE 1-indexed frames from /frames-src/<folder>/frame_0001.jpg… — set CLOUD in canvasScrub.js to stream those from Cloudinary instead.
